title: Working with Collections
excerpt: Collections are the foundation of your content structure in HaruCMS. Learn how to organize and manage your content using collections effectively.
content:
Collections in HaruCMS allow you to organize your content into logical groups. Each collection can have its own schema, defining what fields are available.

Creating Collections

Create a new collection through the admin interface. Define your schema with fields, labels, and types that match your content needs.

Organizing Content

Use collections to separate different types of content. For example, you might have separate collections for blog posts, pages, products, or team members.

This organization makes it easy to manage and display different content types throughout your website.
